title: Facial Reconstruction from Anthropometric Measurements as a Sequential Decision Process
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Federal University of Ceara, Federal University of Ceara and Universidade Federal do Ceara

detail.title: Facial Reconstruction from Anthropometric Measurements as a Sequential Decision Process
detail.abstract: Reconstructing three-dimensional facial geometry from sparse anthropometric measurements is a fundamentally ill-posed inverse problem, where multiple geometries satisfy the same set of constraints. Existing approaches typically address this challenge through optimization-based fitting or direct regression of parametric models. However, both paradigms adopt a static formulation of reconstruction, treating it as a one-shot estimation problem and limiting their ability to handle ambiguity, non-convexity, and sensitivity to initialization. In this work, we propose a conceptual shift by formulating facial reconstruction from anthropometric measurements as a sequential decision-making process. Rather than directly estimating model parameters, we learn a policy that iteratively refines them through corrective updates. Concretely, we cast the estimation of FLAME (Faces Learned with an Articulated Model and Expressions) shape parameters as a continuous Markov Decision Process. This formulation enables adaptive update dynamics that progressively reduce anthropometric error while improving robustness to initialization. Experimental results demonstrate stable convergence and improved robustness compared to static baselines. Beyond facial reconstruction, this work establishes a general framework for addressing ill-posed inverse problems through learned iterative refinement.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将面部三维重建从稀疏人体测量数据的问题重新定义为顺序决策过程，通过强化学习策略迭代优化FLAME模型参数，相比传统静态方法提高了鲁棒性和收敛稳定性。
AI.research_question: 如何从稀疏的人体测量数据中稳健地重建三维面部几何形状，克服传统静态方法在处理模糊性、非凸性和初始化敏感性方面的局限性？
AI.motivation: 从稀疏人体测量数据重建三维面部几何是一个病态逆问题，现有优化拟合或参数回归方法采用静态公式化，无法有效处理模糊性、非凸性和初始化敏感性等挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 将面部重建重新概念化为顺序决策过程；2. 将FLAME形状参数估计建模为连续马尔可夫决策过程；3. 学习迭代细化策略而非直接估计参数。
AI.method: 提出基于强化学习的迭代细化框架：学习一个策略，通过纠正性更新迭代优化FLAME模型参数，实现自适应更新动态，逐步减少人体测量误差并提高对初始化的鲁棒性。
AI.findings: 实验结果表明，相比静态基线方法，该方法实现了稳定的收敛和改善的鲁棒性，能够更好地处理病态逆问题的挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 概念性转变：将面部重建从静态估计问题重新定义为顺序决策过程；2. 建立通用框架：为处理病态逆问题提供基于学习迭代细化的方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发了更稳健的三维面部重建方法；2. 为计算机视觉、生物识别和医疗应用提供了改进的面部建模工具；3. 框架可扩展到其他病态逆问题领域。

title: Harvesting natural points-of-view preferences for arbitrary objects
affiliations: University of Milan, Athens University of Economics and Business, Athens University of Economics and Business and University of Milan

detail.title: Harvesting natural points-of-view preferences for arbitrary objects
detail.abstract: ​Automatically identification of an optimal, representative or relevant viewpoint for a given 3D object is an important task with several applications in digital marketing, visualization, 3D data management and shape retrieval. However, an objective function to optimize the viewpoint is difficult to define in purely geometric terms, given the semantic and aesthetic bias a user is likely to introduce when presented with a target object. Therefore, supervised approaches are a natural candidate to address the problem. This, however, implies the availability of large scale dataset describing natural point-of-view preferences for a number of object categories. In this work, we present an interactive online system designed to continuously harvest and extend such a dataset. The system involves tasking end-users with answering general qualitative questions about a displayed 3D object, while silently collecting point-of-view information. Contrary to related work, we transform the viewpoint selection problem into a latent objective, allowing for an unbiased observation of user behavior in performing various tasks that involve object visualization. We publicly release both our dataset of collected viewpoint statistics and the tool to harvest them, which is easily configurable by experimenters to collect more data in the future or integrate the approach into online 3D viewers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种交互式在线系统，通过收集用户在3D对象可视化任务中的视角偏好数据，为基于监督学习的视角选择问题提供数据集和工具。
AI.research_question: 如何通过用户交互数据收集来支持3D对象最优视角选择的监督学习方法？
AI.motivation: 为3D对象选择最优视角在数字营销、可视化、数据管理和形状检索中很重要，但纯几何方法难以定义客观函数，因为用户具有语义和审美偏好。监督学习需要大规模用户视角偏好数据集。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将视角选择问题转化为潜在目标，通过观察用户在完成3D对象可视化任务时的无偏行为来收集数据。
AI.method: 开发交互式在线系统，让用户回答关于3D对象的定性问题，同时暗中收集视角信息。系统可配置，便于未来收集更多数据或集成到在线3D查看器中。
AI.findings: 公开发布了收集的视角统计数据集和工具，为监督学习方法提供数据支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将视角选择作为潜在目标的框架，避免了直接定义优化函数的困难，通过用户行为观察获得无偏数据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可扩展的交互式数据收集系统和公开数据集，支持未来研究和实际应用中的3D对象视角选择。

title: Digital Engagement as a Stratifying Force? How Digital Engagement Shapes Job Stability in China
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Digital Engagement as a Stratifying Force? How Digital Engagement Shapes Job Stability in China
detail.abstract: Digital engagement has reshaped labor markets worldwide, yet its relationship with job stability—a core dimension of employment quality and a central policy target of China's "steady employment" strategy—remains poorly understood. This study investigates how digital engagement affects job stability and through which mechanisms, drawing on five waves of the China Family Panel Studies (2014-2022). We construct a multi-dimensional job stability index capturing time continuity, institutional security, income security, and subjective perceptions, and employ fixed-effects models with instrumental variable estimation to address endogeneity. Three key findings emerge. First, digital engagement is positively associated with job stability, but this aggregate association conceals three distinct mediating pathways operating in opposite directions. Social capital and psychological capital serve as positive mediators, while entrepreneurship acts as a negative mediator, a pattern particularly pronounced among technology-intensive workers, suggesting that for this group digital engagement may channel workers into self-employment lacking institutional protections. Second, interaction tests reveal that younger workers benefit significantly more from digital engagement than older workers, and workers in high-urbanization regions experience greater stability gains. Third, the relationship exhibits convex increasing returns, indicating that moving workers from basic to advanced digital engagement yields substantially larger stability benefits. These findings carry direct policy implications for China's digital inclusion strategy. While expanding digital access remains important, complementary policies strengthening social networks (particularly for service workers) and psychological resources (across all occupations) could amplify stability gains. Extending social insurance portability to self-employed and platform workers would mitigate the destabilizing side effects of digital-era entrepreneurship.

AI.tldr: 数字参与总体上提升工作稳定性，但通过三种相反的中介路径：社会资本和心理资本起正向作用，而创业起负向作用。年轻工人和高城市化地区工人获益更多，且数字参与存在凸性递增回报。
AI.research_question: 数字参与如何影响工作稳定性？通过哪些机制产生影响？
AI.motivation: 数字参与重塑了全球劳动力市场，但其与工作稳定性（就业质量的核心维度，也是中国"稳就业"战略的政策目标）的关系仍不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于工作稳定性多维度概念（时间连续性、制度保障、收入保障、主观感知），探讨数字参与通过社会资本、心理资本和创业三种中介机制对工作稳定性的影响。
AI.method: 使用中国家庭追踪调查（CFPS）2014-2022年五轮数据，构建多维工作稳定性指数，采用固定效应模型和工具变量估计解决内生性问题。
AI.findings: 1. 数字参与与工作稳定性正相关，但存在三种相反的中介路径：社会资本和心理资本起正向中介作用，创业起负向中介作用（尤其在技术密集型工人中）；2. 年轻工人比年长工人获益更多，高城市化地区工人稳定性增益更大；3. 关系呈现凸性递增回报，从基础到高级数字参与的转变带来更大稳定性收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了数字参与影响工作稳定性的复杂中介机制，特别是识别了创业作为负向中介的意外发现，拓展了数字参与与就业质量关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国数字包容战略提供政策启示：在扩大数字接入的同时，应加强社会网络（特别是服务工人）和心理资源建设，将社会保险可携带性扩展到自雇和平台工人以减轻创业的负面影响。

title: Valuing Nature, Empowering Women: Gendered Insights from Econometric Analysis of Ecological Restoration in Post-Mining Odisha
affiliations: Central University of Punjab, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Delhi, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Delhi

detail.title: Valuing Nature, Empowering Women: Gendered Insights from Econometric Analysis of Ecological Restoration in Post-Mining Odisha
detail.abstract: This study examines the socio-economic and demographic drivers of the perceived importance of ecological restoration and the willingness to pay (WTP) among rural households in the post-mining landscapes of Purnapani, Odisha, India. Using primary household survey data, the analysis applies frequency-weighted Ordered Logit and Tobit regression models to assess the determinants of perceived importance of restoration and willingness to pay (WTP). The findings reveal substantial heterogeneity across gender, age, education, and livelihood dependence. Women exhibit a higher valuation of ecological restoration and a greater willingness to contribute labour, reflecting their close dependence on natural resources and heightened exposure to ecological degradation. In contrast, older and more educated individuals show lower WTP, possibly indicating a preference for state-led interventions. The results also highlight a paradox wherein households with higher ecological dependence demonstrate greater financial commitment but lower perceived importance, suggesting the presence of trust deficits in restoration processes. These findings underscore the need for context-specific and inclusive policy design. The study argues for integrating livelihood concerns with restoration strategies, strengthening gender-inclusive governance, and adopting participatory approaches to enhance community engagement. By aligning ecological objectives with local socio-economic realities, restoration initiatives can achieve greater effectiveness and sustainability in post-mining regions.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨印度奥里萨邦Purnapani矿区农村家庭对生态恢复重要性认知及支付意愿的社会经济与人口驱动因素。研究发现存在显著的性别、年龄、教育和生计依赖异质性，女性更重视生态恢复且更愿意贡献劳动力，而年长和受教育程度高者支付意愿较低。研究强调需要因地制宜的包容性政策设计。
AI.research_question: 在印度奥里萨邦Purnapani矿区后采矿景观中，影响农村家庭对生态恢复重要性认知和支付意愿的社会经济与人口驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 采矿活动对生态环境造成严重破坏，生态恢复对矿区可持续发展至关重要。然而，现有研究对当地社区对生态恢复的态度和参与意愿了解不足，特别是社会经济和人口因素如何影响这些态度。理解这些驱动因素对于设计有效的、包容性的恢复政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境经济学和行为经济学理论，特别是支付意愿理论、生态恢复的社会接受度理论，以及性别与环境关系理论。研究关注社会经济地位、人口特征与环境态度之间的关系。
AI.method: 使用主要家庭调查数据，应用频率加权有序Logit模型和Tobit回归模型，分析生态恢复重要性认知和支付意愿的决定因素。
AI.findings: 1. 性别差异显著：女性对生态恢复的估值更高，更愿意贡献劳动力，反映了她们对自然资源的紧密依赖和更高的生态退化暴露度。2. 年龄和教育影响：年长和受教育程度更高的个体支付意愿较低，可能表明他们更倾向于国家主导的干预。3. 生态依赖悖论：生态依赖度更高的家庭表现出更大的财务承诺但较低的重要性认知，暗示对恢复过程存在信任赤字。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了生态恢复的社会接受度理论，特别关注性别差异和信任因素。2. 揭示了生态依赖与态度之间的复杂关系，挑战了简单线性假设。3. 为环境经济学中的支付意愿研究提供了矿区背景下的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 强调需要因地制宜和包容性的政策设计。2. 建议将生计关切与恢复策略相结合。3. 提倡加强性别包容性治理。4. 推荐采用参与式方法增强社区参与。5. 通过将生态目标与当地社会经济现实相结合，提高恢复计划的有效性和可持续性。

title: Energy-Aware Modular Profiling of the Cheng2020 Learned Image Codec
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Energy-Aware Modular Profiling of the Cheng2020 Learned Image Codec
detail.abstract: As learned image compression moves closer to practical deployment, its energy cost becomes as important as its compression performance. In this work, we study the energy behavior of the encoder of Cheng et al. 2020, a widely used attention based learned image codec, and decompose both latency and directly measured energy across the analysis transform ga, the hyperprior encoder ha, and the entropy bottleneck on an NVIDIA Tesla T4. Our measurements show that the analysis transform overwhelmingly dominates the encoding process, accounting for nearly all computation time, floating point operations, and energy, while the total cost reaches 2.78 J per Kodak sized image and about 6.0 J at 720p. Although the codec delivers strong compression gains relative to JPEG and remains competitive with VVC, these gains do not offset the encoding energy cost unless the content is accessed repeatedly. We also observe that computational cost and latency grow roughly with image resolution, with memory use increasing in the same direction. Taken together, these results identify the analysis transform as the main target for optimization and motivate a practical roadmap based on lighter attention, lower precision inference, and asymmetric codec design to make learned image compression more sustainable at cloud scale

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了基于注意力机制的深度学习图像编码器（Cheng et al. 2020）的能耗特征，发现分析变换（analysis transform）占用了编码过程绝大部分的计算时间、浮点运算和能量消耗，每张Kodak尺寸图像编码能耗达2.78J，720p图像约6.0J。虽然该编解码器相比JPEG有压缩优势，但除非内容被重复访问，否则这些优势无法抵消编码能耗成本。
AI.research_question: 深度学习图像压缩编码器的能耗特征是什么？各组件（分析变换、超先验编码器、熵瓶颈）在能耗和延迟上的分布如何？如何优化以实现更可持续的云规模部署？
AI.motivation: 随着学习型图像压缩技术接近实际部署，其能耗成本变得与压缩性能同等重要。当前基于注意力的学习型图像编解码器虽然压缩性能优越，但缺乏对其能耗特征的系统分析，这阻碍了其在云规模环境中的可持续部署。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于注意力机制的深度学习图像压缩框架（Cheng et al. 2020），包含分析变换（ga）、超先验编码器（ha）和熵瓶颈三个主要组件。研究采用能耗分解分析框架，从计算时间、浮点运算和直接测量能量三个维度评估各组件贡献。
AI.method: 在NVIDIA Tesla T4 GPU上对Cheng et al. 2020编解码器的编码器进行实验测量，分解分析变换、超先验编码器和熵瓶颈的延迟和直接测量能量。测量指标包括计算时间、浮点运算量和能耗，分析不同图像分辨率下的计算成本、延迟和内存使用变化趋势。
AI.findings: 1. 分析变换主导编码过程，占用了几乎所有计算时间、浮点运算和能量消耗；2. 每张Kodak尺寸图像编码能耗达2.78J，720p图像约6.0J；3. 虽然相比JPEG有压缩优势，但除非内容被重复访问，否则这些优势无法抵消编码能耗成本；4. 计算成本和延迟随图像分辨率大致线性增长，内存使用也呈相同趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统分析了基于注意力的学习型图像编码器的能耗特征，提供了各组件能耗分布的量化数据，建立了学习型图像压缩能耗评估的理论框架，为后续能耗优化研究提供了基准。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别分析变换为能耗优化的主要目标，提出了基于轻量注意力、低精度推理和非对称编解码器设计的实用路线图，为学习型图像压缩在云规模环境中的可持续部署提供了具体指导。

title: A Double-Covered Probabilistic Ray-Based Neural Shape Representation
affiliations: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) and Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)

detail.title: A Double-Covered Probabilistic Ray-Based Neural Shape Representation
detail.abstract: Inverse rendering is increasingly favored in solving visual computingproblems, including shape analysis, generation and retrieval, but relyon task-appropriate 3D shape representations for efficiency. This workexplores surface rendering with neural ray fields, which are inherentlymore efficient to render than 3D coordinate-based learning methods,requiring only a single network evaluation per ray, but with high datarequirements and reduced fidelity thus far. We propose an improvedray field with a more stable learning objective function, improvedgradient flow, and a more tractable parameter domain. We study thestrengths and failure modes of the prior art and our method, and howperformance scales with data and compute.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种改进的神经射线场方法，通过更稳定的学习目标函数、改进的梯度流和更易处理的参数域，提高了表面渲染的效率和保真度。
AI.research_question: 如何改进神经射线场方法，以在保持渲染效率的同时提高表面渲染的保真度并降低数据需求？
AI.motivation: 逆渲染在视觉计算问题中应用广泛，但需要任务适当的3D形状表示。神经射线场比基于3D坐标的学习方法渲染效率更高，但现有方法存在数据需求高、保真度低的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 神经射线场（neural ray fields）、表面渲染（surface rendering）、逆渲染（inverse rendering）、3D形状表示理论。
AI.method: 提出改进的射线场方法，包括：1）更稳定的学习目标函数；2）改进的梯度流；3）更易处理的参数域。分析现有方法的优缺点和失败模式，研究性能随数据和计算资源的扩展规律。
AI.findings: 改进后的神经射线场方法在保持单次网络评估每射线的效率优势的同时，提高了渲染保真度，降低了数据需求，并具有更好的稳定性和可训练性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了改进的神经射线场理论框架；2）建立了更稳定的学习目标函数；3）改进了梯度流机制；4）定义了更易处理的参数域。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提高了表面渲染的效率和保真度；2）降低了数据需求；3）为形状分析、生成和检索等视觉计算任务提供了更实用的解决方案；4）提供了性能扩展规律的分析指导。

title: Modelling the interconnected energy systems: The assessment of the merit order price forming in the realm of multizonal 100% RES energy systems
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Pontificia Universidad Católica de Valparaíso, Sapienza University of Rome and Pontificia Universidad Católica de Valparaíso

detail.title: Modelling the interconnected energy systems: The assessment of the merit order price forming in the realm of multizonal 100% RES energy systems
detail.abstract: The transition toward highly renewable energy systems requires large-scale deployment of new generation capacities while maintaining system reliability and economic efficiency. Because renewable energy resources are geographically unevenly distributed, cross-border electricity exchanges and system flexibility become increasingly important for balancing supply and demand. This research analyses the interaction between renewable generation deployment, cross-border electricity flows, and electricity price formation in interconnected energy systems with a high share of variable renewable energy sources. The analysis is performed using the H2RES energy system model, a linear optimization model for long-term capacity expansion and dispatch optimization that includes the power, heating, transport, and industrial sectors. For the purpose of this research, the model was extended with a multizonal module enabling simultaneous simulation of multiple interconnected energy systems and explicit representation of electricity exchanges between zones and neighbouring regions. Transmission between regions is represented through fixed transfer capacities reflecting existing infrastructure constraints. The results show that decarbonization of the analysed systems is primarily achieved through large-scale deployment of variable renewable generation, with solar photovoltaic accounting for the majority of new capacity additions due to its lower investment costs and favourable production profile. In total, 48.84 GW of new renewable generation capacity is installed, of which 42.25 GW corresponds to solar PV and 6.59 GW to wind power. As renewable penetration increases, flexibility technologies such as stationary battery storage and electric vehicles providing vehicle-to-grid services become key balancing options. Analysis of the shadow prices using the electricity balance constraint, representing the marginal system price of electricity supply, indicates a structural shift in price formation: fossil-fuel thermal plants dominate marginal pricing in early years, while flexibility technologies and cross-border electricity exchanges increasingly determine marginal prices in later periods. The growing share of renewable generation leads to a substantial increase in zero-price hours, reaching up to approximately 45% of annual hours in some systems, while average electricity prices decline to approximately 10–20 EUR/MWh by 2050. These results highlight the increasing importance of flexibility technologies and cross-border balancing mechanisms in highly renewable and interconnected electricity systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用H2RES能源系统模型分析高比例可再生能源系统中可再生能源部署、跨境电力流动和电价形成之间的相互作用。研究发现脱碳主要通过大规模部署太阳能光伏实现，随着可再生能源渗透率增加，储能和跨境电力交换在边际定价中作用增强，导致零电价小时显著增加和平均电价下降。
AI.research_question: 高比例可变可再生能源的互联能源系统中，可再生能源部署、跨境电力流动和电价形成之间如何相互作用？
AI.motivation: 向高比例可再生能源系统转型需要大规模部署新发电容量，同时保持系统可靠性和经济效率。由于可再生能源资源地理分布不均，跨境电力交换和系统灵活性对于平衡供需变得越来越重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源系统建模理论、线性优化理论、边际定价理论、可再生能源整合理论、电力市场理论
AI.method: 使用H2RES能源系统模型，这是一个用于长期容量扩展和调度优化的线性优化模型，涵盖电力、供热、交通和工业部门。研究扩展了多区域模块，能够同时模拟多个互联能源系统，并明确表示区域间的电力交换。区域间传输通过反映现有基础设施约束的固定传输容量表示。
AI.findings: 1. 脱碳主要通过大规模部署可变可再生能源实现，其中太阳能光伏占新增容量的大部分（42.25 GW太阳能光伏 vs 6.59 GW风电，总计48.84 GW）。2. 随着可再生能源渗透率增加，固定电池储能和提供车网服务的电动汽车等灵活性技术成为关键平衡选项。3. 电价形成发生结构性转变：早期化石燃料热电厂主导边际定价，后期灵活性技术和跨境电力交换日益决定边际价格。4. 可再生能源份额增加导致零电价小时大幅增加，某些系统达到年小时数的约45%，而平均电价到2050年下降至约10-20 EUR/MWh。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了高比例可再生能源系统中可再生能源部署、跨境流动和电价形成相互作用的系统分析框架。2. 揭示了可再生能源渗透率增加对电价形成机制的结构性影响。3. 量化了可再生能源整合对电力市场价格动态的长期影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了可再生能源转型路径的量化依据。2. 强调了灵活性技术和跨境平衡机制在高度可再生能源系统中的重要性。3. 为电力市场设计和基础设施投资提供了实证参考，特别是关于储能和跨境互联的投资决策。

title: "Aprender idiomas es un privilegio": Exploring L2 English and L3 French motivation in a Colombian secondary school context
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: "Aprender idiomas es un privilegio": Exploring L2 English and L3 French motivation in a Colombian secondary school context
detail.abstract: Research on L2/L3 motivational dynamics has largely been conducted in Global North contexts, leaving the motivational experiences of learners in Latin America substantially underexplored. This mixed-methods study investigates the motivational orientations of 57 Grade 11 Colombian high school learners (L1 Spanish, L2 English, L3 French) using a parallel administration of the Spanish-language Language Learning Orientations Scale (LLOS-IEA; Noels et al., 2000; Fernández-Barrionuevo et al., 2021) to both languages, supplemented by focus group discussion. Quantitative analysis revealed statistically significant differences between L2 English and L3 French motivational profiles across all eight subscales, with large to medium effect sizes, confirming substantial motivational asymmetry in favour of English. The gap was most pronounced in external regulation and identified regulation, reflecting the dominant role of English in Colombian educational policy and social mobility. French intrinsic motivation, while significantly lower than English, remained above the scale midpoint, suggesting residual positive affect that current pedagogy has not adequately harnessed. Focus group data corroborated these findings while also revealing a triangular interference dynamic involving Spanish-French typological proximity, and produced a theoretically significant reframing of the introjected regulation construct with implications for LLOS-IEA validation in Latin American contexts. Learners unanimously identified a desire for communicative, varied, and autonomy-supportive French instruction as a pathway to improved motivation. The study contributes to the growing body of applied linguistics research generating knowledge from and for the Global South.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过混合方法调查了57名哥伦比亚高中生的L2英语和L3法语学习动机，发现英语动机显著高于法语，尤其在外部调节和认同调节方面差异最大。法语内在动机虽较低但仍保持积极，研究还揭示了西班牙语-法语类型学邻近的三角干扰动态，并重构了内摄调节概念。
AI.research_question: 哥伦比亚高中生的L2英语和L3法语学习动机取向有何差异？这些差异如何反映在自我决定理论的各个维度上？
AI.motivation: 现有L2/L3动机研究主要集中在全球北方国家，拉丁美洲学习者的动机体验研究严重不足，特别是哥伦比亚这样的多语环境需要更多关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自我决定理论（SDT），特别是语言学习取向量表（LLOS-IEA）的八个子量表：内在动机、认同调节、内摄调节、外部调节等。
AI.method: 混合方法研究：对57名11年级哥伦比亚高中生（L1西班牙语，L2英语，L3法语）并行使用西班牙语版LLOS-IEA量表测量两种语言动机，辅以焦点小组讨论进行定性分析。
AI.findings:
1. L2英语和L3法语在所有八个动机子量表上存在显著差异，效应值从中等到大
2. 英语动机明显优于法语，差异最大的是外部调节和认同调节
3. 法语内在动机虽显著低于英语，但仍高于量表中点，表明存在未被充分利用的积极情感
4. 发现西班牙语-法语类型学邻近的三角干扰动态
5. 重构了内摄调节概念，对LLOS-IEA在拉丁美洲的验证有重要意义
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 为全球南方语境下的L2/L3动机研究提供实证证据
2. 重构内摄调节概念，完善自我决定理论在拉丁美洲的应用
3. 揭示西班牙语-法语类型学邻近对动机的干扰动态
4. 验证并扩展LLOS-IEA在拉丁美洲语境下的适用性
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为哥伦比亚外语教育政策提供实证依据
2. 指出法语教学需要更多交际性、多样化和自主支持的教学方法
3. 帮助教师识别和利用学生现有的法语积极情感
4. 为拉丁美洲其他国家的多语教育提供参考

title: KII-SVARMAX-Net: A Decoupled Diagnosis-Correction Framework for Volatility-Aware Photovoltaic Power Forecasting
affiliations: Qilu University of Technology, Qilu University of Technology, Qilu University of Technology, Qilu University of Technology and Qilu University of Technology

detail.title: KII-SVARMAX-Net: A Decoupled Diagnosis-Correction Framework for Volatility-Aware Photovoltaic Power Forecasting
detail.abstract: Accurate prediction of photovoltaic (PV) power generation is crucial for mitigating excessive operational losses in the grid system. Owing to the vagueness and intermittency of solar irradiance, such a prediction is very tough. Traditional design methods are smoothing out high-frequency fluctuations by considering them as noise and ignoring them. Nonetheless, jump events may be anticipated with the addition of higher moments in volatility, using the information-rich components of the volatility distribution itself. A volatility-aware diagnostic-correction Framework KII-SVARMAX-Net, is proposed in this paper. The SVARMAX-based network (SVARMAX-Net) with VMD provides stable and trending solutions while varying networks control the volatility of the output. In addition, the Kalman filter does not perform smoothing; this paper uses it for diagnostic purposes on the Kalman Instability Index (KII). This paper repurposes the Kalman filter as a diagnostic tool, introducing the Kalman Instability Index (KII) to quantify in real-time the divergence between expected and observed system states, thereby providing an early indicator of impending power volatility. A physics-informed LightGBM corrector attempts to forecast periods of uncertainty. According to experimental evaluations conducted using the DKASC dataset, the proposed framework achieves an average of 0.1471 kW in terms of RMSE, outperforming the existing state-of-the-art baseline methods. The KII effectively captures rapid fluctuations in generation. Through interpretability analysis, it is established that the framework can aid grid operations in variable weather conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为KII-SVARMAX-Net的波动感知诊断-校正框架，用于准确预测光伏发电功率。该框架结合了SVARMAX网络、卡尔曼滤波诊断和物理信息LightGBM校正器，通过实时监测系统状态差异来预测功率波动，在DKASC数据集上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够有效预测光伏发电功率波动并减少电网运行损失的框架？
AI.motivation: 光伏发电预测对减少电网运行损失至关重要，但由于太阳辐照度的模糊性和间歇性，传统方法将高频波动视为噪声而忽略，无法有效预测跳跃事件。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 波动率分布的高阶矩理论：利用波动率分布本身的信息丰富成分来预测跳跃事件
2. 卡尔曼滤波理论：重新利用卡尔曼滤波作为诊断工具，引入卡尔曼不稳定指数(KII)实时量化预期与观测系统状态之间的差异
3. 物理信息机器学习：结合物理知识的LightGBM校正器
AI.method: 提出KII-SVARMAX-Net框架：1) SVARMAX网络结合VMD提供稳定趋势解；2) 变分网络控制输出波动；3) 卡尔曼滤波作为诊断工具计算KII指数；4) 物理信息LightGBM校正器预测不确定性时期。使用DKASC数据集进行实验评估。
AI.findings:
1. 提出的框架在RMSE上平均达到0.1471 kW，优于现有最先进基准方法
2. KII指数能有效捕捉发电量的快速波动
3. 通过可解释性分析，证实该框架能在多变天气条件下辅助电网运营
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了波动感知诊断-校正框架的理论基础
2. 重新定义了卡尔曼滤波作为诊断工具的角色，引入了KII指数
3. 将物理信息与机器学习方法结合，提高了预测的理论可靠性
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 开发了实用的光伏发电预测框架，可减少电网运行损失
2. 提供了实时监测功率波动的工具(KII指数)
3. 为电网运营商在多变天气条件下的决策提供了技术支持
4. 在真实数据集(DKASC)上验证了方法的有效性

title: Real-time microscopic train rescheduling using graphneural network based reinforcement learning
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Dresden University of Technology and Dresden University of Technology

detail.title: Real-time microscopic train rescheduling using graphneural network based reinforcement learning
detail.abstract: Train operations are often deviated from the planned timetable due to occurringperturbations (i.e., disturbances and disruptions), reducing the efficiencyof train services. Train Timetable Rescheduling (TTR) is therefore anessential task in real-time traffic management to restore punctual and efficienttrain operations after unexpected perturbations. In practice, however,dispatchers have limited decision support tools and very little time to react.This paper introduces Micro-RaiL, the first graph neural network–based deepreinforcement learning framework for microscopic TTR, representing infrastructureat the track circuit level and enabling explicit investigation of switchfailures. We formulate the TTR problem as a Markov Decision Process tobuild the Micro-RaiL framework. A microscopic simulation environment explicitlymodels the state transition function by mapping each state action pairto the subsequent state. A detailed action masking mechanism is designedto accelerate training and ensure solution feasibility. The model is evaluatedon realistic data from a corridor of the German railway network and benchmarkedagainst a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) formulation anda First-Come-First-Served (FCFS) rule with respect to solution quality andcomputational efficiency. Training is performed offline on a set of disruptioninstances, followed by evaluation on 200 unseen disruption scenarios. Theresults demonstrate that the Micro-RaiL method achieves superior practicalperformance, reducing the average total delay by 61% and 96% compared with FCFS and the MILP baseline within 180s, respectively. Furthermore,we illustrate the model’s generalizability to unseen disturbance scenarios andtimetable variations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Micro-RaiL，首个基于图神经网络和深度强化学习的微观列车时刻表重排框架，在德国铁路网络实际数据上验证，相比传统方法显著减少总延误时间。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个高效、实时的微观列车时刻表重排系统，以应对铁路运营中的扰动和中断？
AI.motivation: 列车运营常因扰动（干扰和中断）偏离计划时刻表，降低服务效率。调度员决策支持工具有限且反应时间短，需要开发实时高效的时刻表重排方法。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 图神经网络（GNN）用于微观基础设施表示（轨道电路级别）
2. 深度强化学习（DRL）框架
3. 马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）问题建模
4. 微观仿真环境建模状态转移函数
AI.method:
1. 将列车时刻表重排问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程
2. 开发基于GNN的深度强化学习框架Micro-RaiL
3. 设计详细的动作掩码机制加速训练并确保解可行性
4. 使用德国铁路网络实际数据评估
5. 与混合整数线性规划（MILP）和先到先服务（FCFS）规则对比
AI.findings:
1. Micro-RaiL在180秒内将平均总延误分别比FCFS和MILP基线减少61%和96%
2. 模型对未见过的扰动场景和时刻表变化具有良好的泛化能力
3. 在200个未见中断场景评估中表现优异
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 首次提出基于图神经网络和深度强化学习的微观列车时刻表重排框架
2. 在轨道电路级别表示基础设施，支持道岔故障的显式研究
3. 设计了加速训练的动作掩码机制
4. 建立了微观仿真环境建模状态转移函数
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为调度员提供高效的实时决策支持工具
2. 显著减少列车延误，提高铁路运营效率
3. 模型可泛化到不同扰动场景和时刻表变化
4. 在实际铁路网络数据上验证了有效性

title: Operational and Structural Determinants of Eco-Efficiency in Maritime Container Trade
affiliations: University of Toulon, University of Toulon and Kedge Business School Bordeaux

detail.title: Operational and Structural Determinants of Eco-Efficiency in Maritime Container Trade
detail.abstract: In the context of IMO environmental policies, reducing carbon emissions from international shipping may come at the expense of countries’ connectivity and development. This article proposes a method to estimate container trade-related CO₂ intensity from 214 container services deployed in 2025 and aggregate emissions at the country level. It then uses a two-stage data envelopment analysis model to assess the eco-efficiency of bilateral trade. Results show substantial room for improvement, as fewer than 5% of links are efficient and carbon intensity differs markedly between main and secondary routes. Operational speed, fleet characteristics, and competition all contribute to eco-inefficiency, while technical cooperative agreements between carriers, such as strategic alliances, are associated with better eco-efficiency. These findings suggest that future IMO policies should further support fleet modernisation, reconsider competition policy, and limit adverse effects on secondary routes.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了国际集装箱贸易的生态效率，发现仅有不到5%的贸易链路是高效的，主要航线与次要航线碳强度差异显著。运营速度、船队特征和竞争导致生态低效，而航运公司间的技术合作协议（如战略联盟）则与更好的生态效率相关。
AI.research_question: 在IMO环境政策背景下，如何评估双边集装箱贸易的生态效率？哪些因素影响贸易链路的碳强度和生态效率？
AI.motivation: 减少国际航运碳排放可能以牺牲国家连通性和发展为代价，需要平衡环境保护与贸易发展，评估现有贸易模式的生态效率以指导政策制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态效率理论、数据包络分析（DEA）、国际贸易与环境关系理论、航运经济学。
AI.method: 1. 基于214个2025年部署的集装箱服务估算贸易相关的CO₂强度；2. 在国家层面汇总排放；3. 使用两阶段数据包络分析模型评估双边贸易生态效率。
AI.findings: 1. 仅有不到5%的贸易链路是生态高效的；2. 主要航线与次要航线的碳强度差异显著；3. 运营速度、船队特征和竞争导致生态低效；4. 航运公司间的技术合作协议（如战略联盟）与更好的生态效率相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将生态效率评估框架应用于国际集装箱贸易；2. 识别影响航运生态效率的关键因素；3. 为IMO环境政策提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议IMO政策应支持船队现代化；2. 重新考虑竞争政策；3. 限制对次要航线的不利影响；4. 促进航运公司间的技术合作。

title: The RTO Paradox: Why Mandates May Cost You More Than They Deliver
affiliations: West Texas A&M University, West Texas A&M University and West Texas A&M University

detail.title: The RTO Paradox: Why Mandates May Cost You More Than They Deliver
detail.abstract: Return-to-office mandates have become one of today’s most divisive leadership decisions. Many executives frame full-time presence as a path to culture, collaboration, and control; employees experience higher costs, reduced autonomy, and rising burnout. Whereas there was some initial exploration of the topic as pandemic restrictions were lifted, this essay explains the developing executive logic behind mandates, surfaces the lived employee reality, and examines the core flaw that confuses visibility with value. It then offers a practical design for the future of work that treats offices as hubs for intentional convening rather than compulsory presence, and positions outcome-based management as the norm. The central claim: presence is not performance. Organizations that embrace flexibility with clarity and rigor will keep their best people and outperform those that rely on mandates.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了强制返岗政策的争议性，指出高管将办公室出勤视为文化、协作和控制的手段，而员工则面临成本增加、自主权减少和倦怠加剧的问题。文章揭示了将"可见性"等同于"价值"的核心缺陷，并提出将办公室设计为有意聚集的枢纽，以结果为导向的管理模式。核心主张是：出勤不等于绩效。
AI.research_question: 强制返岗政策为何成为当今最具争议的领导决策？如何设计更有效的工作未来模式？
AI.motivation: 强制返岗政策已成为当今最具分歧的领导决策，高管和员工对此存在根本性认知差异，需要深入分析其背后的执行逻辑和员工现实体验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 可见性与价值混淆理论；2. 结果导向管理理论；3. 工作场所设计理论；4. 组织灵活性与绩效关系理论
AI.method: 本文采用批判性分析方法和概念性框架构建，通过分析高管逻辑与员工现实体验的对比，揭示强制返岗政策的核心缺陷。
AI.findings: 1. 高管将全职出勤视为文化、协作和控制的手段；2. 员工体验包括成本增加、自主权减少和倦怠加剧；3. 核心缺陷是将"可见性"误认为"价值"；4. 办公室应作为有意聚集的枢纽而非强制出勤场所；5. 结果导向管理应成为规范。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了"可见性不等于价值"的核心理论命题；2. 发展了工作场所设计的理论框架；3. 丰富了组织灵活性与绩效关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为组织设计未来工作模式提供实用框架；2. 提出将办公室作为有意聚集枢纽的具体设计方案；3. 倡导结果导向管理实践；4. 为领导者制定灵活工作政策提供指导原则。

title: Unsupervised Learning for Optimal Trade Area Identification in ECOWAS: A Comparative Analysis of Hierarchical, K-Means, and Fuzzy C-Means Clustering
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, The University of the Basque Country and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Unsupervised Learning for Optimal Trade Area Identification in ECOWAS: A Comparative Analysis of Hierarchical, K-Means, and Fuzzy C-Means Clustering
detail.abstract: This study looks at the different trade and economic patterns within the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) using unsupervised learning methods. We use Hierarchical Clustering, K-Means, and Fuzzy C-Means algorithms on standardized trade and economic indicators to find hidden groupings among member states. The results show a three-cluster structure that includes (i) a leading economic hub, (ii) medium-sized economies with fairly strong trade infrastructure, and (iii) smaller, low-performing economies. While hard clustering methods create moderately distinct groups, fuzzy clustering reveals oiverlapping memberships, showing the close connections in regional trade systems. The findings also indicate a lack of agreement between the clusters we found and formal regional groups like UEMOA and MRU. This suggests that economic fundamentals matter more than institutional ties in shaping trade behavior. The study adds to pattern recognition in economic systems and provides useful insights for regional integration and improving trade.

title: Discriminant Analysis using Weighted Multivariate Normal Distributions
affiliations: Shahid Chamran University of Ahvaz and Shahid Chamran University of Ahvaz

detail.title: Discriminant Analysis using Weighted Multivariate Normal Distributions
detail.abstract: Standard Linear and Quadratic Discriminant Analysis (LDA and QDA) rely heavily on the assumption of simple random sampling, often failing to account for the biased data collection mechanisms prevalent in real-world scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose a generalized classification framework based on Form-Invariant Weighted Multivariate Normal Distributions. By introducing linear ($w_1$) and quadratic ($w_2$) exponential weight functions, we analytically model preferential sampling and derive the exact modified discriminant functions. The theoretical impact of these weighting mechanisms on class separability is rigorously established using the Kullback-Leibler divergence and the Bhattacharyya distance, providing formal bounds on the Bayes error rate. Empirical evaluations validate the mathematical framework: in our simulation study, optimizing the linear weight function ($w_1$) successfully reshaped the decision boundary for heteroscedastic data, improving accuracy and sensitivity. Furthermore, applying the quadratic weight function ($w_2$) to the real-world Pima Indians Diabetes dataset enhanced the structural flexibility of the model, yielding higher overall diagnostic accuracy ($75.76\%$) and significantly reducing false-positive errors compared to classical QDA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于形式不变加权多元正态分布的广义分类框架，通过引入线性和二次指数权重函数来建模偏好抽样，推导出精确的修正判别函数，解决了传统LDA和QDA在现实世界偏倚数据收集机制下的局限性。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够有效处理现实世界偏好抽样数据的广义分类框架，以克服传统线性判别分析和二次判别分析在偏倚数据收集机制下的局限性？
AI.motivation: 传统的LDA和QDA严重依赖简单随机抽样假设，无法处理现实世界中普遍存在的偏倚数据收集机制，这限制了它们在真实应用场景中的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于形式不变加权多元正态分布的理论框架，引入线性（w₁）和二次（w₂）指数权重函数来建模偏好抽样机制，使用Kullback-Leibler散度和Bhattacharyya距离建立类可分性的理论影响分析。
AI.method: 通过分析推导加权多元正态分布的精确修正判别函数，进行模拟研究验证线性权重函数对异方差数据的决策边界重塑效果，并在Pima印第安人糖尿病数据集上应用二次权重函数进行实证评估。
AI.findings: 模拟研究中优化线性权重函数成功重塑了异方差数据的决策边界，提高了准确性和敏感性；在真实数据集上应用二次权重函数将诊断准确率提升至75.76%，显著降低了假阳性错误。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了形式不变加权多元正态分布的广义分类框架，建立了偏好抽样对类可分性的理论影响分析，为贝叶斯错误率提供了形式化边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为处理现实世界偏倚数据提供了实用的分类方法，在医疗诊断等应用中显著提高了模型准确性和可靠性，减少了误判风险。

title: TopoGNN: Heterogeneous B-Rep Graph Learning with NURBS-Based Geometric Embeddings for Industrial Machining Feature Recognition
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Technische Universität München (TUM)

detail.title: TopoGNN: Heterogeneous B-Rep Graph Learning with NURBS-Based Geometric Embeddings for Industrial Machining Feature Recognition
detail.abstract: Machining Feature Recognition (MFR) remains challenging on industrial CAD models because complex feature interactions, irregular topology, and free-form geometry are only partially captured by discretized 3D representations and face-only CAD graphs. We propose TopoGNN, a CAD-native framework that operates directly on STEP boundary representations and models CAD parts as heterogeneous face–edge–vertex graphs with orientation-aware incidence, adjacency, and loop-order relations. To encode geometry, the method combines NURBS- and UV-based descriptors with type-specific self-supervised variational autoencoders for faces, edges, and vertices, whose embeddings are processed by a relation-aware heterogeneous graph neural network for per-face prediction. We evaluate the approach on the Fusion 360 Gallery benchmark, the TMCAD classification benchmark, and a proprietary industrial dataset of annotated machining operations. TopoGNN achieves 97.21\% accuracy and 0.8757 mIoU on Fusion 360, 82.60\% accuracy and 0.4698 mIoU on the industrial dataset, and 88.50\% accuracy on TMCAD. Ablation studies show that the largest gains arise from the heterogeneous topological formulation, while learned geometric embeddings provide complementary improvements over compact handcrafted descriptors. These results indicate that explicit B-Rep topology together with learned parametric geometry is an effective basis for robust CAD-native recognition in both public and industrial settings.

AI.tldr: TopoGNN是一个直接操作于STEP边界表示的CAD原生框架，通过异构图神经网络结合拓扑关系和几何编码，在多个数据集上实现了高精度的加工特征识别。

AI.motivation: 当前加工特征识别在工业CAD模型上面临挑战，因为复杂的特征交互、不规则拓扑和自由曲面几何在离散化3D表示和仅含面的CAD图中仅被部分捕获。

1. 异构面-边-顶点图表示CAD零件，包含方向感知的关联、邻接和环序关系
2. 结合NURBS和UV描述符的几何编码方法
3. 针对面、边、顶点的类型特定自监督变分自编码器
4. 关系感知的异构图神经网络
AI.method:
1. 将CAD零件建模为异构面-边-顶点图
2. 使用NURBS-和UV-based描述符编码几何信息
3. 为面、边、顶点分别训练自监督变分自编码器
4. 通过关系感知的异构图神经网络进行面级预测
5. 在Fusion 360 Gallery、TMCAD分类基准和工业数据集上评估
AI.findings:
1. 在Fusion 360上达到97.21%准确率和0.8757 mIoU
2. 在工业数据集上达到82.60%准确率和0.4698 mIoU  
3. 在TMCAD上达到88.50%准确率
4. 消融研究表明最大增益来自异构拓扑公式化
5. 学习的几何嵌入相比紧凑手工描述符提供补充改进
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了CAD原生框架TopoGNN，直接操作于STEP边界表示
2. 建立了异构面-边-顶点图表示方法，包含完整的拓扑关系
3. 开发了结合参数几何学习和拓扑感知的识别方法
4. 验证了显式B-Rep拓扑结合学习参数几何的有效性
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 在多个公开和工业数据集上实现了高精度加工特征识别
2. 为工业CAD模型的特征识别提供了实用解决方案
3. 框架可直接应用于实际工业环境中的CAD模型处理
4. 为CAD/CAM集成和智能制造提供了技术支持

title: Mapping Generative AI in Marketing: A Systematic Review of Emerging Dimensions for Responsible and Sustainable Practice
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Universidade Lusófona, Lisbon, Al-Nahrain University, Abu Dhabi University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Mapping Generative AI in Marketing: A Systematic Review of Emerging Dimensions for Responsible and Sustainable Practice
detail.abstract: This study examines how generative artificial intelligence is reshaping marketing and identifies the main dimensions that structure its emerging use in a responsible and sustainable manner. Although interest in GenAI in marketing has expanded rapidly, the literature remains fragmented across technological, managerial, consumer, and ethical perspectives. To address this fragmentation, the study conducts a systematic literature review following PRISMA guidelines and combines qualitative thematic synthesis with bibliometric mapping. The review focuses on peer-reviewed studies published between 2023 and 2024 and identifies seven interrelated dimensions: technological capability, content creation, operational efficiency, personalization, consumer trust, ethical governance, and innovation orientation. The findings show that GenAI offers significant opportunities for scalable content generation, adaptive customer engagement, and process efficiency, but also introduces tensions related to authenticity, transparency, bias, privacy, and consumer autonomy. These tensions indicate that GenAI should not be approached solely as a performance-enhancing tool, but as a governance-sensitive marketing capability whose long-term value depends on accountability and trust. By integrating dispersed research streams, the study offers a structured framework for future research and provides guidance for managers and policymakers seeking to align GenAI adoption with responsible and sustainable marketing practice.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过系统文献综述，识别了生成式AI在营销中负责任和可持续应用的七个关键维度，指出GenAI既是提升绩效的工具，也是需要治理的营销能力，其长期价值取决于问责制和信任。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能如何重塑营销？构成其负责任和可持续应用的主要维度是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管对GenAI在营销中的兴趣迅速增长，但现有文献在技术、管理、消费者和伦理视角上仍然分散，缺乏整合框架来指导负责任和可持续的应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了技术能力理论、负责任创新理论、消费者信任理论和营销治理理论，构建了一个多维度的分析框架。
AI.method: 遵循PRISMA指南的系统文献综述，结合定性主题综合分析和文献计量映射，聚焦2023-2024年发表的同行评审研究。
AI.findings: 识别了七个相互关联的维度：技术能力、内容创作、运营效率、个性化、消费者信任、伦理治理和创新导向。GenAI在可扩展内容生成、适应性客户参与和流程效率方面提供显著机会，但也引发了真实性、透明度、偏见、隐私和消费者自主权方面的紧张关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了分散的研究流，为未来研究提供了结构化框架；将GenAI概念化为治理敏感的营销能力而非单纯绩效工具；强调了问责制和信任在长期价值创造中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者和政策制定者提供了指导，帮助他们将GenAI采用与负责任和可持续的营销实践相结合；识别了关键维度和潜在风险，支持决策制定。

title: Cross-border e-commerce transaction fraud detection based on feature engineering: a dynamic transaction network aggregation analytical framework
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Cross-border e-commerce transaction fraud detection based on feature engineering: a dynamic transaction network aggregation analytical framework
detail.abstract: Cross-border e-commerce transaction fraud has emerged as a focal point of current concern, and the application of machine learning algorithms for fraud detection is becoming increasingly prevalent. However, existing methods lack a universal integrated analytical framework, have limited applicability, and are inadequate in recognizing identity concealment. To address these challenges, a generative dynamic transaction network aggregation analytical framework is proposed. This framework first achieves dynamic classification of transactions through similarity-weighted sums of nodes with the same attributes and adaptive weighting. Next, a backward merging mechanism is introduced to construct an associated transaction network that captures latent behavioral connections. Additionally, a Generative Adversarial Network is utilized to enhance fraudulent samples, thereby alleviating class imbalance. An improved hybrid gray wolf optimization algorithm is employed for global optimization of weights, enhancing the model's adaptability. Empirical research conducted on a real cross-border transaction dataset demonstrates that the proposed framework significantly outperforms traditional aggregation feature methods in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score (p<0.05). Furthermore, the core mechanisms of the framework demonstrate general applicability, as they do not rely on preset features of specific datasets; it can be utilized with any data that includes identity and transaction information. This framework is extendable to fraud detection scenarios involving identity concealment and transaction behavior analysis, such as in cross-border e-commerce and online payments.

title: Social Media Content Types and Consumer Service Evaluation: How Digital Communication Shapes Brand Perceptions and Visit Intentions in Cross-Border Healthcare Services

detail.title: Social Media Content Types and Consumer Service Evaluation: How Digital Communication Shapes Brand Perceptions and Visit Intentions in Cross-Border Healthcare Services
detail.abstract: This study examines how different types of social media content influence foreign patients’ evaluations and visit intentions toward healthcare providers. Drawing on the Elaboration Likelihood Model, signaling theory, and uncertainty reduction theory, we develop an integrated framework explaining how digital communication shapes healthcare decision-making under conditions of high perceived risk and information asymmetry.Using survey data from 409 foreign residents in South Korea and structural equation modeling, we analyze the effects of informational, remunerative, entertaining, and relational content on brand image, brand attitude, and visit intention. The results indicate that informational and relational content significantly enhance brand-related evaluations, whereas remunerative and entertaining content undermine perceived credibility. Furthermore, brand image emerges as a stronger predictor of visit intention than brand attitude.This study contributes to retailing and consumer services research by specifying the cognitive and signaling mechanisms through which digital content shapes evaluations of credence-based service providers. The findings offer actionable guidance for service managers seeking to build brand credibility and reduce perceived risk among customers who face information asymmetry prior to service consumption.

title: From Distinction to Convergence: The Evolving Relationship Between Infrastructure and Private Equity
affiliations: Tilburg University

detail.title: From Distinction to Convergence: The Evolving Relationship Between Infrastructure and Private Equity
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the potential convergence between infrastructure equity and private equity investment performance using two decades of fund data and deal-level valuation multiples. Fund-level analysis reveals a time-varying co-movement between infrastructure and large private equity buyout funds, with shared characteristics such as cash flow stability and scale. At the deal level, valuation multiples exhibit high correlation between infrastructure- and private equity, especially over the past decade, further supporting the convergence narrative. More granularly, deal classes reveal a more complex dynamic and inconclusive findings. The distributions of financial deals in the two asset classes resemble each other closely. However, on a correlation basis, financial infrastructure deals co-move strongly with venture capital deals, as do corporate infrastructure deals and financial private equity deals. Overall, these findings suggest that investors may need to reassess diversification strategies, and that policymakers should consider evolving risk frameworks to account for fading asset-class boundaries.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用20年基金数据和交易层面估值倍数，探讨基础设施股权与私募股权投资绩效的潜在趋同。研究发现基金层面存在时变联动，交易层面估值倍数高度相关，但细分交易类别呈现更复杂动态。投资者需重新评估多元化策略，政策制定者应考虑调整风险框架。

title: From fragmentation to integration: The IVBEL model of ethical leadership as a normative anchor
affiliations: National University of Sciences and Technology

detail.title: From fragmentation to integration: The IVBEL model of ethical leadership as a normative anchor
detail.abstract: Value-based leadership research has expanded across multiple paradigms, yet remains conceptually fragmented, theoretically overlapping, and insufficiently attentive to cultural and contextual variation. This conceptual paper addresses these limitations by developing the Integrated Value-Based Ethical Leadership (IVBEL) Model as a theory of integration. The model reconceptualizes ethical leadership as a normative anchor that functions as a boundary condition, regulatory mechanism, and legitimacy validator, structuring how complementary leadership capacities are enacted rather than operating as a parallel construct. Drawing on an integrative review of ethical, transformational, authentic, servant, and spiritual leadership, the paper advances a boundary-constrained and configurational integration logic in which paradigms operate as interdependent capabilities whose effects are conditioned by ethical regulation rather than combined additively.The IVBEL Model specifies a mechanism architecture in which ethical leadership governs the activation of vision, authenticity, service, and meaning, generating complementary and conditional effects. It further explains how these interactions produce multilevel cascading outcomes: shaping moral cognition and identity at the micro level, diffusing into ethical climates and coordination at the meso level, and reinforcing institutional legitimacy at the macro level. Cross-cultural moral logics are embedded as mechanism-level enactment pathways that shape how ethical principles are expressed without altering their normative core.By specifying how integration operates—rather than merely documenting overlap—the model reduces construct redundancy and advances a mechanism-based, multilevel framework. In doing so, it shifts value-based leadership theory from comparative fragmentation toward normatively anchored integration, offering a more precise and globally relevant account of leadership effectiveness.

title: Operational Optimization of Building Energy Systems via Data-Driven Mode-Based Control Strategies

detail.title: Operational Optimization of Building Energy Systems via Data-Driven Mode-Based Control Strategies
detail.abstract: Improving energy use in the built environment is crucial, as building activities account for a significant share of global energy consumption and emissions. Unfortunately, the transferability of many sophisticated control techniques developed for building planning and design is limited, severely reducing their usefulness in actual building operations. This research presents an information-driven structure that applies mode-based control methods to operate building energy systems, extending their application beyond the design phase to address this challenge. Automatic control generation is made possible by a data-driven procedure. An open architecture supports cloud-based prediction and personal execution. The framework incorporates hierarchy-based fuzzy logic systems (HFLCs) for selecting optimal operating modes and LSTM networks for forecasting key system state variables. In a case study based on simulations of a home Using a system of ground-source heat pumps, the method is shown to be effective, reducing operating expenses by 24% and power consumption by 15% compared to the current state of the art. Based on these findings, the suggested approach provides a feasible and scalable way to improve building energy efficiency and reduce operating expenses by integrating control techniques developed during the planning stage with real-time operations.

title: New Patterns in Springboard Theory
affiliations: University of Miami - Department of Management

detail.title: New Patterns in Springboard Theory
detail.abstract: More than two decades after the introduction of the springboard perspective, the global environment confronting emerging market multinationals (EMNEs) has been fundamentally reshaped by intensifying geopolitical tensions, techno-nationalism, regulatory tightening, and retreat from hyper-globalization. This article advances five new patterns to enrich springboard theory—greater complexities, more divergence, complex re-routing, increased re-alignment, and collective springboarding—to illuminate how the logic of springboarding is being reconstituted under contemporary conditions. We argue that springboarding is not just a sequential asset-seeking pathway associated with latecomer catch-up, but also a multi-layered and geopolitically conditioned strategic calculus in which firms recalibrate ownership structures, leverage intermediary hubs, pursue collaborative and platform-based expansion, and engage in collective or bidirectional capability exchange. The EMNE population has become increasingly stratified, spanning early-stage asset seekers to global frontrunners capable of reverse knowledge transfer. Under each of the five new patterns, we articulate forward-looking research directions that identify key theoretical extensions and analytical lenses for understanding the next phase of EMNE internationalization in a multipolar global order.

title: Polycrises and MNE Strategy: Interactions of Geopolitical and Environmental Risks
affiliations: Villanova University, Purdue University Fort Wayne, ,  and University of Miami - Department of Management

detail.title: Polycrises and MNE Strategy: Interactions of Geopolitical and Environmental Risks
detail.abstract: Climate change and geopolitical instability both affect multinational enterprises, but research has typically studied these risks separately. We argue this approach is now inadequate because these two forces not only coexist as parallels but also interact, creating compounding effects that increase asset vulnerability and disrupt multinationals’ operations in unpredictable ways. We outline the bidirectional interactions between environmental and geopolitical risks, explain their effects on multinationals, and provide a framework for multinationals to navigate the dual effects of these crises by integrating political foresight with climate risk modeling, thereby fundamentally redesigning global strategy and governance frameworks. We advance a more integrative view of multinational strategy by highlighting how the compounded risks of polycrises can cause MNEs to pursue either extractive environmental capabilities or regenerative environmental capabilities. We also call for future research to move beyond single-risk and static frameworks to those that examine how interdependent global disruptions jointly reconfigure firm behavior, performance, and governance over time.

title: Fishing Port Efficiency Performance and Improvement Strategies to Support Environmentally Friendly Fish Supply Management in the Papua-Java Corridor, Indonesia ​
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Bogor Agricultural University (IPB University), University of Iceland and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Fishing Port Efficiency Performance and Improvement Strategies to Support Environmentally Friendly Fish Supply Management in the Papua-Java Corridor, Indonesia ​
detail.abstract: The fishing ports involved in managing fish supplies in the Papua-Java Corridor are Poumako Fishing Port, Mayangan Fishing Port, and Nizam Zachman Fishing Port. However, the role of these ports is considered suboptimal, particularly in implementing efficiency principles and environmentally friendly fish supply practices. The study aimed to analyze the efficiency performance of these ports and develop priority strategies for improvement to support environmentally friendly fish supply management. The study used descriptive methods, the correlation method, efficiency performance analysis, and the analytical hierarchy process (AHP). The analysis revealed that the efficiency performance of fishing ports in the Papua-Java Corridor ranged from 2.600 to 2.633 on a scale of 1-4 (categorized as sufficient). The lowest performance was at Poumako Fishing Port, the fish production base. The dominant causes of inefficiency were manual loading and unloading, less-skilled crew and unloading officers, bureaucratic fish handling, and waste/garbage-handling facilities located far from the dock. To improve the efficiency performance, we recommend several priority strategies: developing a fast and integrated loading and unloading system (IR=0.144) at Poumako Fishing Port, developing technical training for fish transit and industrial fish handling (IR=0.128) at Mayangan Fishing Port, and simplifying the administrative flow for fish unloading and handling (IR=0.131) at Nizam Zachman Fishing Port. These strategies impact environmentally friendly fish supply management by minimizing waste from vessels and waiting personnel, reducing emissions from passing vessels, reducing stress on crew and workers, reducing damage to fish supplies, and reducing the potential for work accidents at the port and at sea.

title: Bi-objective optimization for demand-responsive bus services under many-to-one elastic demand
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Peng Cheng National Laboratory, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Lancaster University

detail.title: Bi-objective optimization for demand-responsive bus services under many-to-one elastic demand
detail.abstract: Featuring variable stops, routes, and schedules, the demand-responsive bus (DRB) holds great promise for advancing public transit, yet many real-world deployments have failed due to financial unsustainability.  Motivated by this, this study develops a continuous approximation (CA) model for designing a many-to-one DRB system under linear elastic demand regarding service quality, aiming to reconcile two equally important but conflicting objectives: maximizing profit and minimizing passenger cost.  This DRB system employs a dynamic stop-based service mode, with its operations elaborated along timelines.  In our CA model, the Beardwood-Halton-Hammersley (BHH) and Kendall-Moran (KM) formulas are used to estimate zonal travel and access distances, respectively, with their coefficients calibrated via Monte Carlo simulations.  Three decision variables---the line-haul distance, headway, and service zone size---are optimized both individually and jointly. The analytical Pareto optimal sets are derived individually for each variable, offering theoretical insights into the trade-off mechanisms. For joint optimization, the $\varepsilon$-constraint method is employed to generate an exact numerical Pareto optimal set that forms a one-dimensional curvilinear locus in the three-dimensional decision space.  Numerical results yield actionable insights for both the planning and operational phases of DRB systems: joint optimization informs planning-stage design, while univariate optimization supports operational-stage adjustments. Furthermore, sensitivity analysis assesses the impacts of several key exogenous parameters on system performance.
