title: A Diffusion-Driven Two-Stage Optimization Approach for Large-Scale Traveling Salesman Problems with a Drone
affiliations: Hefei University of Technology, Hefei University of Technology, Hefei University of Technology, Hefei University of Technology and Hefei University of Technology - Key Laboratory of Process Optimization and Intelligent Decision-Making (MOE)

detail.title: A Diffusion-Driven Two-Stage Optimization Approach for Large-Scale Traveling Salesman Problems with a Drone

keywords: Large-Scale Traveling Salesman Problem with Drone

detail.abstract: The Traveling Salesman Problem with a Drone (TSP-D) has attracted considerable attention due to its potential to coordinate a truck and a drone for efficient last-mile delivery.Developing effective solution approaches for large-scale TSP-D instances remains a challenge due to the combinatorial complexity of the problem. The route-first–split-second paradigm is a well-known heuristic framework in large-scale TSP-D, where an initial truck-only tour is first constructed and subsequently partitioned into coordinated truck–drone operations.In such frameworks, the structural properties of the initial tour critically affect the quality of the resulting TSP-D solution, particularly under varying customer densities and heterogeneous vehicle speeds.This study proposes a novel diffusion-driven two-stage optimization approach for large-scale TSP-D. In the first stage, a diffusion model learns structural patterns from high-quality TSP tours and generates multiple structurally diverse and high-quality initial tours. In the second stage, these tours are further optimized by downstream TSP-D solution procedures to yield high-quality feasible TSP-D solutions.By providing multiple low-cost and structurally advantageous initial tours, the proposed approach significantly improves the effectiveness of the route-first–split-second framework.Computational experiments on benchmark instances with 175, 250, 375, and 500 nodes confirm that the proposed approach consistently outperforms classical heuristic approaches in terms of solution quality and stability across different problem scales and data distributions. These results underscore the potential of embedding discrete diffusion models into two-stage frameworks as a promising direction for large-scale TSP-D.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的两阶段优化方法，用于解决大规模旅行商问题与无人机协同配送问题，通过生成结构多样且高质量的初始路径来提升解决方案质量。
AI.research_question: 如何提高大规模旅行商问题与无人机协同配送问题的解决方案质量？
AI.motivation: 由于组合复杂性，大规模TSP-D实例的有效解决方案开发仍然具有挑战性；现有route-first-split-second框架中初始路径的结构特性对最终解决方案质量有重要影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于route-first-split-second启发式框架，结合扩散模型学习高质量TSP路径的结构模式，构建两阶段优化方法。
AI.method: 提出扩散驱动的两阶段优化方法：第一阶段使用扩散模型从高质量TSP路径学习结构模式，生成多个结构多样且高质量的初始路径；第二阶段通过下游TSP-D解决方案程序进一步优化这些路径。
AI.findings: 在175、250、375和500个节点的基准实例上，该方法在解决方案质量和稳定性方面始终优于经典启发式方法，且在不同问题规模和数据分布下表现一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 将离散扩散模型嵌入两阶段框架，为大规模TSP-D问题提供了新的研究方向；证明了初始路径结构多样性对最终解决方案质量的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种有效的大规模TSP-D解决方案，能够生成多个低成本且结构优势的初始路径，显著提高了route-first-split-second框架的有效性。

title: GEOPOLITICAL SHOCKS, CAPITAL-PROVIDER ADVANTAGE, AND MINORITY STAKES IN DEFENCE TECHNOLOGY
affiliations: CHRIST (Deemed to be University)

detail.title: GEOPOLITICAL SHOCKS, CAPITAL-PROVIDER ADVANTAGE, AND MINORITY STAKES IN DEFENCE TECHNOLOGY
detail.abstract: This article evaluates a marginalized discussion of whether the 2022 Russia-Ukraine war changed the deal structure in defence and aerospace by causing Bluechip strategic acquirers to prefer minority ownership in acquiring advanced-capability companies. Previously, real-options theory suggested that higher techno-geopolitical uncertainty should lead to higher staged strategic commitment. Rather, the increase in minority stakes post-2022 can be described more persuasively as a capital-ecology change, as advanced-capability opportunities are increasingly likely to be funded by various types of venture methods and other financial sponsors at smaller disclosed ticket sizes. In strategic-only transactions, no post-2022 reduction towards minorities emerges. Ultimately, this article contributes a disciplined understanding of capital-provider advantage for defence funding during geopolitical uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，2022年俄乌战争并未改变国防航空领域战略收购方的交易结构偏好，战略收购方仍偏好全资收购而非少数股权。少数股权交易增加主要源于资本生态变化，更多风险投资等金融资本进入该领域。
AI.research_question: 2022年俄乌战争是否改变了国防航空领域战略收购方的交易结构偏好，使其更倾向于少数股权收购先进技术公司？
AI.motivation: 传统实物期权理论认为，技术地缘政治不确定性增加应导致更高的分阶段战略承诺（如少数股权）。但2022年俄乌战争后国防航空领域少数股权交易增加的现象需要重新解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实物期权理论（Real-options theory）与资本生态理论（Capital-ecology theory）的对比分析。
AI.method: 对2022年俄乌战争前后国防航空领域交易数据的实证分析，比较战略收购方与金融投资者的交易结构差异。
AI.findings: 1. 战略收购方在纯战略交易中并未转向少数股权偏好；2. 少数股权交易增加主要源于风险投资等金融资本进入该领域；3. 交易规模变小反映了资本生态变化而非战略收购方行为改变。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了实物期权理论在技术地缘政治不确定性下的预测，提出了资本生态理论作为更有效的解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国防企业在地缘政治不确定性下的融资策略提供指导，帮助理解不同类型资本提供者的优势差异。

title: Environmental Impact of Aviation Growth: A Decadal Analysis and Engineering-Driven Efficiency Gains
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Environmental Impact of Aviation Growth: A Decadal Analysis and Engineering-Driven Efficiency Gains
detail.abstract: The aviation industry's rapid expansion creates major difficulties for decarbonization goals. Technological improvements have led to better efficiency, yet higher flight frequencies result in an "efficiency-growth paradox." This study investigates this paradox by analyzing a decadal dataset (2015–2025) of monthly CO₂ emissions across 16 European states using the Prophet time-series forecasting algorithm, projecting environmental effects until 2030 under Business-as-Usual (BAU) scenarios. Emissions now exceed 2019 levels after a V-shaped recovery from the pandemic downturn. Seasonal decomposition reveals peak emissions during the third quarter. The Engineering-Driven Efficiency Scenario shows that advanced lightweight composites and mechatronic flight management systems could deliver 5% fuel efficiency improvements by 2030, reducing CO₂ emissions by 122.41 million tons between 2025 and 2030, compared to BAU projections of 250.57 million tons in 2030. Decoupling aviation growth from carbon intensity requires integrating material science with intelligent mechatronic systems, offering a framework for policymakers and engineers.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用Prophet时间序列预测算法分析欧洲16国2015-2025年航空CO₂排放数据，预测到2030年的环境效应。研究发现航空排放已超过2019年水平，呈现V型复苏，第三季度排放最高。工程驱动效率情景显示，先进轻质复合材料和机电飞行管理系统可使2030年燃油效率提升5%，相比常规情景减少122.41百万吨CO₂排放。
AI.research_question: 航空业的"效率-增长悖论"如何影响欧洲国家的CO₂排放？先进工程技术和智能机电系统能否有效实现航空增长与碳排放强度的脱钩？
AI.motivation: 航空业快速扩张给脱碳目标带来重大挑战。虽然技术进步提高了效率，但航班频率增加导致"效率-增长悖论"——效率提升被增长抵消。需要研究这一悖论对碳排放的实际影响，并探索技术解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 效率-增长悖论理论、脱碳理论、时间序列分析理论、工程效率与技术扩散理论
AI.method: 使用Prophet时间序列预测算法分析欧洲16国2015-2025年月度CO₂排放数据，预测到2030年的排放趋势。进行季节性分解，比较常规情景与工程驱动效率情景。
AI.findings: 1. 航空排放已超过2019年水平，呈现V型复苏；2. 第三季度排放最高；3. 工程驱动效率情景下，先进轻质复合材料和机电飞行管理系统可使2030年燃油效率提升5%；4. 相比常规情景的250.57百万吨排放，工程情景可减少122.41百万吨CO₂排放（2025-2030年）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 实证验证了航空业的"效率-增长悖论"；2. 提出了材料科学与智能机电系统整合的脱碳框架；3. 为时间序列分析在环境政策研究中的应用提供了新案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了2030年航空排放的预测数据；2. 展示了工程技术创新（轻质复合材料和智能飞行系统）的实际减排潜力；3. 为航空业脱碳提供了具体的技术路径和政策建议框架。

title: Leadership Styles and Employee Productivity in Post-Pandemic Remote Work Settings
affiliations: University of Electro-Communications

detail.title: Leadership Styles and Employee Productivity in Post-Pandemic Remote Work Settings
detail.abstract: Leadership Styles and Employee Productivity in Post-Pandemic Remote Work SettingsAbstractPurpose:This research set out to explore how various leadership styles can influence the productivity of employees in remote working conditions after the pandemic. It aims to determine the best leadership strategies to improve performance, engagement, and well-being in virtual and hybrid workplaces.Design/Methodology/Approach:The systematic literature review was performed in accordance with the PRISMA framework and involved 30 peer-reviewed studies published in 2020-2026. Major academic databases, such as Scopus, Web of science and Google Scholar, have been used to collect data. Predefined inclusion criteria were used to evaluate the selected studies and organise them using descriptive and thematic analysis.Findings:The results indicate that transformational leadership is the best leadership approach that can be used to enhance employee productivity, engagement, and well-being in remote work settings. Transactional leadership promotes task arrangement and responsibility, but is not very successful in motivation. New styles such as servant, adaptive, and digital leadership will improve teamwork and resilience, whereas a laissez-faire leadership approach will adversely affect productivity.Originality/Value:This paper gives a critical summary of the effectiveness of leadership during post-pandemic remote working conditions and how conventional theories of leadership apply to the digital world. It presents viable suggestions to organisations and adds to the literature of the field by establishing hybrid and adaptive leadership as contributors to high productivity.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过系统文献综述发现，在后疫情远程工作环境中，变革型领导最能提升员工生产力、参与度和幸福感，而放任型领导则有负面影响。
AI.research_question: 不同领导风格如何影响后疫情时代远程工作环境中员工的生产力？
AI.motivation: 疫情后远程和混合工作模式成为常态，需要探索最适合虚拟工作环境的领导策略，以提高员工绩效、参与度和幸福感。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于传统领导理论（变革型领导、交易型领导、放任型领导），并扩展到新兴领导风格（服务型领导、适应性领导、数字领导）。
AI.method: 采用PRISMA框架进行系统文献综述，分析2020-2026年间30篇同行评审研究，使用描述性和主题分析整理数据。
AI.findings: 变革型领导最有效提升远程工作生产力；交易型领导促进任务安排但激励不足；服务型、适应性、数字领导能改善团队合作和韧性；放任型领导对生产力有负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将传统领导理论应用于数字环境，建立混合和适应性领导作为高生产力贡献者的理论框架，丰富远程工作领导力文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供可行的领导策略建议，帮助管理者在远程和混合工作环境中优化员工生产力、参与度和幸福感。

title: Unpacking Technology Turbulence as a Higher-Order Boundary Condition on the interactive effect of AI adoption between Agile Methods and Project Success
affiliations: Bahria University and Bahria University

detail.title: Unpacking Technology Turbulence as a Higher-Order Boundary Condition on the interactive effect of AI adoption between Agile Methods and Project Success
detail.abstract: Drawing on dynamic capability theory, we investigated the direct effects of agile methods, AI adoption, and technology turbulence; the moderating roles of AI adoption and technology turbulence; and moderated moderation of technology turbulence on the interaction of AI adoption and agile methods. We analyzed survey data collected from 187 architecture and construction professionals, using CB-SEM. Findings reveal positive direct impact of agile methods on project success while AI adoption and technology turbulence strengthen the relationships functioning as pure moderators. Furthermore, the negative three-way interaction suggests that higher-level turbulence weakens the synergistic effect of AI, while lower-order interactions remain insignificant.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于动态能力理论，探讨敏捷方法、AI采用和技术动荡对项目成功的直接影响，以及AI采用和技术动荡的调节作用，并检验技术动荡对AI采用与敏捷方法交互的调节调节效应。
AI.research_question: 敏捷方法、AI采用和技术动荡如何影响项目成功？AI采用和技术动荡在敏捷方法与项目成功关系中起什么调节作用？技术动荡如何调节AI采用与敏捷方法的交互效应？
AI.motivation: 建筑行业面临数字化转型和技术快速变化的挑战，需要理解敏捷方法、AI技术采用以及外部技术环境动荡如何共同影响项目成功，为行业实践提供指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态能力理论（Dynamic Capability Theory）
AI.method: 问卷调查法，收集187名建筑行业专业人士数据，使用协方差结构方程模型（CB-SEM）进行分析
AI.findings: 1. 敏捷方法对项目成功有直接正向影响；2. AI采用和技术动荡作为纯粹调节变量，强化了敏捷方法与项目成功的关系；3. 三向交互效应显示，高水平技术动荡会削弱AI的协同效应，而低阶交互效应不显著
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展动态能力理论在建筑项目管理中的应用；2. 揭示AI采用和技术动荡的调节作用机制；3. 发现技术动荡对AI与敏捷方法协同效应的复杂调节作用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为建筑企业实施敏捷方法提供实证支持；2. 指导企业在不同技术动荡环境下优化AI采用策略；3. 帮助管理者理解技术环境对数字化转型效果的影响

title: Evolution of Terrorist Attack Risk Assessment Methodologies: A Literature Review of the ”Likelihood-Vulnerability-Consequence” Tripartite Framework
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Evolution of Terrorist Attack Risk Assessment Methodologies: A Literature Review of the ”Likelihood-Vulnerability-Consequence” Tripartite Framework
detail.abstract: Terrorist attacks, marked by deliberate intent and adaptation, require evaluation methods distinct from those used for natural disasters or accidents. This review examines the development of risk assessment within the "Likelihood-Vulnerability-Consequence" (LVC) framework. Likelihood assessment has progressed from historical frequency analysis toward multi-dimensional modeling that integrates spatial attractiveness, machine-learning situational awareness, and game-theoretic simulations against adaptive adversaries. Vulnerability assessment increasingly utilizes modular "Detection-Delay-Response" (DDR) designs, treating physical security parameters as integrated time-and-probability functions of system resilience. Consequence evaluation connects micro-scale incident simulations with macro-level estimates of regional socio-economic impact. The findings show a shift from static qualitative methods toward dynamic quantitative models focused on adversarial interaction. Future research aims to address data scarcity using few-shot learning and Large Models (LMs), while incorporating IoT-based sensing to enable real-time early warning.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了恐怖袭击风险评估方法的发展，从传统的静态定性方法转向基于"可能性-脆弱性-后果"（LVC）框架的动态定量模型，重点关注对抗性互动。
AI.research_question: 恐怖袭击风险评估方法如何从传统的静态定性方法演变为基于LVC框架的动态定量模型？
AI.motivation: 恐怖袭击具有故意意图和适应性特征，需要与自然灾害或事故不同的评估方法，现有风险评估框架需要适应这种对抗性威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"可能性-脆弱性-后果"（LVC）框架，整合空间吸引力理论、机器学习情境感知、博弈论对抗模拟、检测-延迟-响应（DDR）设计等理论。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，分析恐怖袭击风险评估领域的发展趋势，包括历史频率分析、多维建模、系统韧性评估和宏观社会经济影响估计。
AI.findings: 可能性评估从历史频率分析转向整合空间吸引力、机器学习情境感知和博弈论模拟的多维建模；脆弱性评估采用模块化DDR设计；后果评估连接微观事件模拟与宏观社会经济影响估计；整体趋势是从静态定性方法转向关注对抗性互动的动态定量模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了恐怖袭击风险评估的理论框架演进路径，整合了对抗性互动建模、系统韧性理论和动态风险评估方法，为安全科学领域提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为安全实践提供了基于LVC框架的动态风险评估工具，支持实时早期预警系统设计，并为应对数据稀缺问题提供了小样本学习和大型模型的应用方向。

title: Feature Sensitivity and Robustness in Corrosion Rate Forecasting: A Comparative Study of Deterministic and Probabilistic Machine Learning Models
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Feature Sensitivity and Robustness in Corrosion Rate Forecasting: A Comparative Study of Deterministic and Probabilistic Machine Learning Models
detail.abstract: Accurate corrosion rate prediction is critical for ensuring industrial infrastructure safety and reducing economic losses. However, existing models often fail to balance precision, uncertainty quantification, and adaptability to dynamic scenarios. This study systematically compared the Extra Trees Regressor (ETR) and an Improved Bayesian Neural Network (ImprovedBNN) across static performance metrics (MSE, MAE, coverage), feature sensitivity to ±10% fluctuations, and statistical robustness via paired t-tests. The results show that ETR outperformed in point prediction (MSE=0.0051), while ImprovedBNN delivers perfect predictive interval coverage (1.000) and exhibits enhanced responsiveness to critical corrosion-driving features. The two models exhibit distinct performance trade-offs that map directly to different industrial use cases. These findings establish a practical model selection framework for corrosion management, bridging the gap between deterministic predictive precision and probabilistic risk rigor to support evidence-based decision-making.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统比较了Extra Trees Regressor（ETR）和改进贝叶斯神经网络（ImprovedBNN）在腐蚀速率预测中的性能，发现ETR在点预测精度上更优，而ImprovedBNN在预测区间覆盖和特征敏感性方面表现更好，为工业应用提供了模型选择框架。
AI.research_question: 在腐蚀速率预测中，如何平衡预测精度、不确定性量化和动态场景适应性？ETR和ImprovedBNN在静态性能指标、特征敏感性和统计稳健性方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: 准确的腐蚀速率预测对工业基础设施安全和减少经济损失至关重要，但现有模型往往难以平衡精度、不确定性量化和动态场景适应性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机器学习预测模型理论，特别是集成学习（Extra Trees Regressor）和贝叶斯神经网络理论，结合不确定性量化方法和统计检验理论。
AI.method: 系统比较ETR和ImprovedBNN在静态性能指标（MSE、MAE、覆盖率）、特征敏感性（对±10%波动的响应）和统计稳健性（配对t检验）方面的表现。
AI.findings: ETR在点预测精度上表现更好（MSE=0.0051），而ImprovedBNN提供完美的预测区间覆盖率（1.000）并对关键腐蚀驱动特征表现出更强的响应性。两种模型展现出不同的性能权衡，直接对应不同的工业应用场景。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了腐蚀管理中的实用模型选择框架，弥合了确定性预测精度和概率风险严谨性之间的差距，为基于证据的决策提供支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工业腐蚀管理提供了具体的模型选择指导：当需要高精度点预测时选择ETR，当需要不确定性量化和风险分析时选择ImprovedBNN，支持工业基础设施的安全管理和经济决策。

title: Corporate Taxes and Operating Cost Behavior: Evidence from Private Firms
affiliations: Free University of Berlin (FUB) and University of Navarra, IESE Business School

detail.title: Corporate Taxes and Operating Cost Behavior: Evidence from Private Firms
detail.abstract: Using a panel of unconsolidated financial statements for European private firms, we present evidence that corporate taxes amplify the responsiveness of operating costs to sales, consistent with conforming tax planning within firms’ operating activities. We also document tax-driven cost stickiness: The tax-induced change in operating cost is stronger when sales increase than when sales decrease. Further, we find substantial cross-sectional variation, with stronger effects for smaller firms and for firms operating on dispersed markets. Taken together, our results suggest that corporate taxes affect reported pre-tax cost behavior and contribute to cost stickiness.

AI.tldr: 使用欧洲私营企业未合并财务报表数据，研究发现公司税通过遵从性税收筹划影响运营成本对销售的敏感性，并导致成本粘性现象。
AI.research_question: 公司税如何影响企业运营成本对销售变动的响应性？是否存在税收驱动的成本粘性现象？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注税收对融资和投资决策的影响，但对税收如何通过企业日常运营活动影响成本行为的研究较少。理解税收对成本结构的影响有助于更全面认识税收的经济后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 遵从性税收筹划理论、成本行为理论、成本粘性理论
AI.method: 使用欧洲私营企业未合并财务报表的面板数据，分析运营成本对销售变动的响应性如何受公司税影响，检验成本增加和减少时的不对称效应。
AI.findings: 1) 公司税增强了运营成本对销售的响应性；2) 存在税收驱动的成本粘性：销售增加时税收诱导的成本变化比销售减少时更强；3) 效应在小企业和分散市场运营企业中更显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 将税收因素纳入成本行为理论框架，提出并验证税收驱动成本粘性的概念，拓展了税收经济后果的研究边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供税收规划对成本管理影响的实证证据，为政策制定者理解税收对企业运营决策的影响提供参考，特别是对小企业和特定市场结构企业的启示。

title: Contamination, enrichment, and ecological risk assessment of potentially toxic metals in topsoil surrounding a limestone quarry in Balaka, Malawi
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Malawi

detail.title: Contamination, enrichment, and ecological risk assessment of potentially toxic metals in topsoil surrounding a limestone quarry in Balaka, Malawi
detail.abstract: Limestone quarrying can release potentially toxic metals into surrounding soils through dust and disturbance, affecting soil quality and safety. This study evaluated concentrations, contamination, and ecological risks of Cu, Ni, Zn, Mn, Cd, Cr, and Pb in topsoil at distances of 0 m, 100 m, 200 m, 300 m, 400 m, and 2000 m (background) from a limestone quarry in Balaka, Malawi. Metals were extracted from 1 g of soil in 50 mL of solution and converted to mg/kg. Contamination was assessed using the Contamination Factor (CF), Geoaccumulation Index (Igeo), Pollution Load Index (PLI), and Potential Ecological Risk Index (PERI). Source apportionment employed PCA and APCS-MLR, whereas human health risks (non-carcinogenic and carcinogenic) were assessed in accordance with USEPA guidelines. Results indicated elevated pH and reduced organic matter near the quarry (0 m), with cadmium peaking at this distance. Manganese and chromium increased with distance, suggesting wider dust dispersion. CF and Igeo showed low to moderate contamination, with nickel displaying the strongest accumulation. PLI exceeded 1 at all sites, confirming multi-metal pollution, while PERI remained moderate (primarily cadmium-driven). Source analysis identified a dominant quarry-related source near the site and a secondary dispersed source farther away. Non-carcinogenic (HI << 1) and carcinogenic risks (CR 10−7 to 10−5) were negligible for children and adults, well below USEPA and WHO thresholds. The quarry causes moderate soil alteration with limited ecological risk and negligible human health risk. Dust suppression, buffer zones, and routine monitoring are recommended to safeguard soil quality and community well-being in Balaka.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了马拉维Balaka石灰石采石场周边土壤中重金属的污染状况、生态风险和健康风险。结果显示采石场导致土壤pH升高、有机质减少，存在多金属污染但生态风险中等，健康风险可忽略。建议采取粉尘控制、缓冲区和定期监测措施。
AI.research_question: 石灰石采石场周边土壤中重金属（Cu、Ni、Zn、Mn、Cd、Cr、Pb）的浓度分布、污染程度、生态风险及人类健康风险如何？
AI.motivation: 石灰石开采会通过粉尘和扰动向周边土壤释放潜在有毒金属，影响土壤质量和安全。马拉维Balaka地区采石活动对周边土壤环境的影响尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 污染评估理论：污染因子(CF)、地质累积指数(Igeo)、污染负荷指数(PLI)、潜在生态风险指数(PERI)；源解析理论：主成分分析(PCA)和绝对主成分得分-多元线性回归(APCS-MLR)；健康风险评估理论：美国环保署(USEPA)非致癌和致癌风险评估指南。
AI.method: 在采石场0m、100m、200m、300m、400m和2000m（背景点）采集表层土壤样品，提取Cu、Ni、Zn、Mn、Cd、Cr、Pb等7种金属，浓度转换为mg/kg。使用CF、Igeo、PLI、PERI评估污染程度和生态风险，采用PCA和APCS-MLR进行源解析，依据USEPA指南评估人类健康风险。
AI.findings: 1) 采石场附近(0m)土壤pH升高、有机质减少，镉浓度最高；2) 锰和铬浓度随距离增加，表明粉尘扩散范围广；3) CF和Igeo显示低到中度污染，镍积累最强；4) PLI在所有位点均>1，确认多金属污染；5) PERI显示中等风险（主要由镉驱动）；6) 源解析识别出采石场主导源和远处次要扩散源；7) 非致癌风险(HI<<1)和致癌风险(CR 10−7到10−5)对儿童和成人都可忽略。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提供了发展中国家石灰石采石场周边土壤重金属污染的系统评估框架；2) 验证了多种污染指数在采石场环境评估中的适用性；3) 揭示了采石活动对土壤重金属分布的空间影响模式；4) 建立了源解析与风险评估的整合方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为Balaka地区采石场环境管理提供科学依据；2) 建议采取粉尘抑制、缓冲区设置和定期监测措施；3) 评估结果显示当前风险可控，为社区健康安全提供保障；4) 为类似采石场环境评估提供可借鉴的方法和标准。

title: Eﬀicient Heuristic Design: A Study of Small Language Models in Combinatorial and Continuous Optimization
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Tanta University, Tanta University and Tanta University

detail.title: Eﬀicient Heuristic Design: A Study of Small Language Models in Combinatorial and Continuous Optimization
detail.abstract: As depicted in recent research, large language models (LLMs) can produce competitive optimization heuristics when embedded in evolutionary search frameworks. However, most existing approaches rely on proprietary cloud-based models such as GPT-4, which incurs considerable financial costs and limits access for many research groups. To address these challenges, this paper investigates the ability of small language models to perform automated heuristic design within an evolutionary context. The ReEvo algorithmic framework is extended to work with several locally deployable models, namely DeepSeek-R1-Distill (1.5B), Gemma-3 (4B), LLaMA-3.1 (8B), and GLM-4-Flash. In addition to revisiting prior work on combinatorial optimization, we present a novel extension of the framework to continuous optimization that allows language models to evolve genetic algorithm operators, specifically crossover and mutation strategies. The proposed system is evaluated on two classes of problems: (1) five continuous benchmark functions across varying dimensions, and (2) three combinatorial routing problems, including the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP), Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), and Orienteering Problem (OP). Experimental results reveal that small language models can generate competitive heuristics comparable to those produced by large language models. Several continuous functions, including Ackley and Rastrigin, attained machine-precision optimality at lower dimensionality via evolved operators. In combinatorial scenarios, Gemma-3 (4B) achieved a mean TSP-50 tour length of $5.950 \pm 0.063$ across five independent runs, closely matching results published in previous work utilising substantially larger proprietary models, with no statistically significant differences between models. These findings suggest that cost-effective, locally deployable language models can make a significant contribution to ..

AI.tldr: 本文研究了小型语言模型在进化算法框架中自动设计优化启发式的能力，发现小型本地可部署模型（如DeepSeek-R1-Distill、Gemma-3等）能够生成与大型专有模型相媲美的竞争性启发式，显著降低了成本并提高了可访问性。
AI.research_question: 小型语言模型能否在进化搜索框架中有效执行自动启发式设计，生成与大型专有模型相媲美的竞争性优化启发式？
AI.motivation: 现有基于大型语言模型的优化启发式生成方法主要依赖GPT-4等云端专有模型，导致高昂的财务成本和访问限制，限制了研究群体的广泛参与。
AI.theoretical_framework: 进化算法框架（ReEvo扩展）、语言模型驱动的自动启发式设计、遗传算法算子（交叉和变异策略）的演化、连续优化与组合优化的统一框架。
AI.method: 扩展ReEvo算法框架以支持多种本地可部署小型语言模型；在连续优化问题中演化遗传算法算子；在两类问题上评估：5个连续基准函数（不同维度）和3个组合路由问题（TSP、CVRP、OP）。
AI.findings: 小型语言模型能够生成与大型语言模型相媲美的竞争性启发式；在连续优化中，Ackley和Rastrigin等函数通过演化算子达到了机器精度最优；在组合优化中，Gemma-3（4B）在TSP-50上的表现与先前使用大型专有模型的结果无显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了小型语言模型在自动启发式设计中的有效性；扩展了语言模型驱动的进化算法框架到连续优化领域；建立了小型模型与大型模型在优化性能上的可比性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了成本效益高、本地可部署的优化启发式生成方案；降低了自动启发式设计的财务门槛；使更多研究群体能够参与语言模型驱动的优化研究。

title: A Novel Global and Local Evolutionary Framework with Heterogeneous Environmental Selection for Solving Imbalanced Multimodal Multiobjective Optimization Problems
affiliations: Guizhou University, Guizhou University, Guizhou University, Guizhou University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Novel Global and Local Evolutionary Framework with Heterogeneous Environmental Selection for Solving Imbalanced Multimodal Multiobjective Optimization Problems

keywords: imbalanced problems with local Pareto fronts

detail.abstract: Most multimodal multiobjective algorithms exhibit premature convergence when addressing multimodal multi-objective problems with imbalance characteristics. Some algorithms only focus on the balance between convergence and diversity in the decision space, leading to inferior diversity in the objective space. This paper proposes a novel global and local evolutionary framework with heterogeneous environmental selection for solving imbalanced multimodal multiobjective optimization problems. Specifically, the proposed algorithm alternates between global exploration and local exploitation. Aiming to explore new modals and merge some modals, the algorithm utilizes a global evolution method to select parents and generate offspring. After global exploration, the algorithm uses density-based clustering to identify modals. Then, the algorithm performs independent evolution within each modal. In addition, a heterogeneous environmental selection strategy is developed based on the evolutionary state of each modal to handle modals with varying search difficulties. In summary, the global exploration and local exploitation are conducted alternatively to balance convergence and diversity. The experimental results on 32 benchmark problems demonstrate the promising performance of the proposed algorithm compared with 5 state-of-the-art algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的全局-局部进化框架，采用异构环境选择策略来解决不平衡多模态多目标优化问题，通过交替进行全局探索和局部开发来平衡收敛性和多样性。
AI.research_question: 如何有效解决具有不平衡特性的多模态多目标优化问题，同时平衡决策空间和目标空间的多样性？
AI.motivation: 现有大多数多模态多目标算法在处理具有不平衡特性的问题时存在早熟收敛问题，且一些算法仅关注决策空间的收敛与多样性平衡，导致目标空间多样性不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于全局-局部进化框架理论，结合异构环境选择策略，通过交替进行全局探索和局部开发来平衡收敛性和多样性。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的全局-局部进化框架：1）全局探索阶段使用全局进化方法选择父代并生成子代，探索新模态并合并部分模态；2）基于密度聚类识别模态；3）在每个模态内进行独立进化；4）基于每个模态的进化状态开发异构环境选择策略，处理不同搜索难度的模态。
AI.findings: 在32个基准问题上进行实验，结果表明所提算法相比5种最先进算法表现出优越性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了全局-局部交替进化框架；2）开发了基于模态进化状态的异构环境选择策略；3）为解决不平衡多模态多目标优化问题提供了新的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供了一种能有效平衡决策空间和目标空间多样性的算法；2）能够处理具有不同搜索难度的模态；3）在实际多模态多目标优化问题中具有应用潜力。

title: Wired for Soft Skills: Early Life High-Speed Internet Exposure and Personality Traits
affiliations: University of International Business and Economics, Xi'an Jiaotong University and Fudan University

detail.title: Wired for Soft Skills: Early Life High-Speed Internet Exposure and Personality Traits
detail.abstract: This paper examines the long-term effects of childhood exposure to high-speed Internet on personality traits. Using China's 2000 Internet speed-up program as a plausible exogenous policy shock, we construct regional intensities in high-speed Internet exposure, combining with the cohort variations, we find that individuals exposed to high-speed Internet in childhood (ages 0-12) exhibit significantly higher levels of extraversion, conscientiousness, and agreeableness, compared to unexposed cohorts. Mechanism analysis reveals an improvement in the home environment. The study highlights the importance of information and communication technology (ICT) in human capital accumulation beyond traditional cognitive skills.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用中国2000年互联网提速计划作为外生政策冲击，发现童年期（0-12岁）接触高速互联网的个体在成年后表现出更高的外向性、责任心和宜人性，机制分析表明这源于家庭环境的改善。
AI.research_question: 童年期接触高速互联网对人格特质有何长期影响？
AI.motivation: 信息通信技术（ICT）对人类发展的影响研究多集中于认知技能，而对非认知技能（如人格特质）的长期影响缺乏了解，特别是在发展中国家背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人力资本理论，将ICT视为人力资本积累的重要投入；结合人格心理学的大五人格模型；采用家庭环境改善作为中介机制的理论框架。
AI.method: 利用中国2000年互联网提速计划作为准自然实验，构建地区层面的高速互联网暴露强度指标，结合队列差异进行双重差分分析，识别童年期互联网暴露对人格特质的因果效应。
AI.findings: 童年期（0-12岁）接触高速互联网显著提高了成年后的外向性、责任心和宜人性；机制分析表明家庭环境的改善是主要作用渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了ICT对人力资本影响的理论边界，从认知技能延伸到非认知技能；为童年环境对人格发展的长期影响提供了新的证据；丰富了发展中国家数字技术社会影响的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了ICT投资对人力资本发展的全面评估依据；强调了改善家庭数字环境对儿童发展的重要性；为教育和社会政策设计提供了实证支持。

title: Can Role Models and Skills Training Increase Women's Voice in Asset Selection? Experimental Evidence from Odisha, India
affiliations: International Food Policy Research Institute (IFPRI), , International Food Policy Research Institute, International Food Policy Research Institute (IFPRI) and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Can Role Models and Skills Training Increase Women's Voice in Asset Selection? Experimental Evidence from Odisha, India
detail.abstract: We test whether a light-touch intervention can enhance women’s influence in local development under India’s MGNREGA, the world’s largest public works program. In a randomized controlled trial with 2,600 women across 94 villages in the state of Odisha, we evaluate the impacts of exposure to female role models on behaviors related to successfully requesting assets under the program, with or without participatory skills training. Role models alone have limited effects, but the combined intervention increases women’s asset demands, aspirations, self-efficacy, and objectively assessed knowledge and public speaking skills. Effects are strongest among older women and those in less elite-dominated villages. Results suggest scalable interventions can bolster women’s voice in decentralized governance, conditional on individual and institutional context.

AI.tldr: 一项在印度奥里萨邦进行的随机对照试验发现，仅提供女性榜样对提升妇女在MGNREGA项目中的影响力效果有限，但榜样与参与式技能培训相结合能显著提高妇女的资产需求、抱负、自我效能感以及客观评估的知识和公开演讲技能。
AI.research_question: 轻量级干预能否增强妇女在印度MGNREGA（全球最大的公共工程项目）地方发展中的影响力？
AI.motivation: 研究旨在探索可扩展的干预措施如何增强妇女在分权治理中的话语权，特别是在全球最大的公共工程项目MGNREGA背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于角色榜样理论、自我效能感理论和参与式发展理论，探讨个体特征（如年龄）和制度环境（如村庄精英主导程度）如何调节干预效果。
AI.method: 在印度奥里萨邦94个村庄对2,600名妇女进行随机对照试验，评估单独提供女性榜样、榜样与参与式技能培训结合两种干预对妇女在MGNREGA项目中成功申请资产相关行为的影响。
AI.findings: 单独角色榜样效果有限，但组合干预显著提高妇女的资产需求、抱负、自我效能感、知识和公开演讲技能。效果在年长妇女和精英主导程度较低的村庄中最强。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于揭示了增强妇女在分权治理中话语权的干预机制，强调了角色榜样与技能培训的互补作用，以及个体特征和制度环境的调节效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献在于提供了一种可扩展的干预模式，帮助政策制定者设计更有效的妇女赋权项目，特别是在大型公共工程项目中增强妇女参与和影响力。

title: Conscious Coupling: Engaging Husbands to Address Intrahousehold Constraints for Women Entrepreneurs in Ethiopia
affiliations: World Bank, World Bank, Geneva Graduate Institute and World Bank

detail.title: Conscious Coupling: Engaging Husbands to Address Intrahousehold Constraints for Women Entrepreneurs in Ethiopia
detail.abstract: Intrahousehold dynamics are frequently cited as a key constraint to women’s economic achievement. Using a randomized controlled trial, we test whether husband’s participation increases the returns to a women’s entrepreneurship program that was adapted to build relational skills and address household constraints. Married women entrepreneurs are randomly assigned to participate alone, with their husbands, or to a control group. Findings suggest that the program leads to an increase in the adoption of good business practices and a 30% rise in women’s sole decision-making power over their businesses. Husband’s participation amplifies program impacts: women with smaller firms gain over 50% higher revenues and profits, while those with larger firms increase access to business loans. These effects are not driven by changes in husband’s behavior (e.g., by doing more household tasks or supporting their wife’s business). Instead, the program works by strengthening women’s communication and negotiation skills, increasing their ability to reallocate time and access resources without increasing marital conflict.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过随机对照试验发现，让丈夫参与女性创业项目能显著提升项目效果：小企业女性收入利润增长50%以上，大企业女性获得更多商业贷款。项目通过增强女性沟通谈判技能而非改变丈夫行为来发挥作用。
AI.research_question: 丈夫参与是否会增强女性创业项目的效果？如果是，其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 家庭内部动态常被视为女性经济成就的关键制约因素，但现有研究对如何有效解决这一约束了解有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于家庭内部动态理论、性别角色理论和创业资源获取理论，探讨家庭关系对女性创业成功的影响机制。
AI.method: 随机对照试验：已婚女性创业者被随机分配到三组：单独参与项目、与丈夫共同参与项目、对照组。项目专门设计用于培养关系技能和解决家庭约束。
AI.findings: 1) 项目本身能提高良好商业实践采用率，并使女性对企业决策权增加30%；2) 丈夫参与能放大项目效果：小企业女性收入利润增长50%以上，大企业女性获得更多商业贷款；3) 效果并非通过改变丈夫行为实现，而是通过增强女性沟通谈判技能，使其能重新分配时间和获取资源而不增加婚姻冲突。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 揭示了丈夫参与女性创业项目的具体作用机制；2) 挑战了"丈夫行为改变"的传统解释框架；3) 强调了女性自身能力提升在克服家庭约束中的核心作用。

title: Carbon source-driven metabolic pH modulation enables robust arsenic removal from acidic wastewater by manganese-oxidizing aerobic granular sludge

detail.title: Carbon source-driven metabolic pH modulation enables robust arsenic removal from acidic wastewater by manganese-oxidizing aerobic granular sludge
detail.abstract: The treatment of arsenic-containing acidic wastewater (As-AW) from mining and metallurgical industries remains technically challenging due to the dual stressors of low pH and high toxicity. Here we report a self-alkalinizing manganese-oxidizing aerobic granular sludge (Mn-AGS) biotechnology that overcomes this limitation through carbon-source-mediated metabolic pH regulation. By comparing sodium acetate and glucose as carbon sources, we discovered that acetate degradation drives progressive alkalization (pH 7.0→9.5) via proton consumption, creating favorable microenvironments for manganese oxidation, whereas glucose metabolism maintains near-neutral pH. The acetate-cultivated pH-increasing Mn-AGS achieved high Mn(II)-oxidizing activity (120 ± 1 mg Mn(IV)/L) and maintained structural integrity under acidic stress. During As-AW treatment (pH 4.0-7.0), this system sustained 50.2-69.3% As(III) removal, which was further enhanced to 89.2% upon Fe(II) supplementation. Mechanistic investigations revealed a synergistic cascade: acetate metabolism simultaneously elevates pH and generates carbonate species; the alkaline microenvironments promote biogenic MnOx formation; MnOx oxidizes As(III) to less toxic As(V); and Fe(II) addition triggers Fenton-like oxidation while forming iron (hydr)oxides that immobilize As as stable Fe/Mn oxide-bound fractions. Microbial community analysis identified Paracoccus as the core Mn(II)-oxidizing genus, with acid-tolerant Hydrogenophaga and Flavobacterium proliferating under Fe(II)-amended conditions as putative As(III)-oxidizers. This work establishes carbon source selection as a critical design parameter for engineering Mn-AGS with intrinsic pH-buffering capacity, providing a sustainable strategy for direct acidic wastewater treatment without pre-neutralization.

AI.research_question: 如何开发一种能够直接处理低pH、高毒性含砷酸性废水的生物技术，克服传统方法需要预中和的局限性？
AI.motivation: 采矿和冶金行业产生的含砷酸性废水处理面临低pH和高毒性的双重压力，传统方法需要预中和处理，技术挑战大
AI.theoretical_framework: 碳源代谢调控pH理论、锰氧化生物矿化理论、砷氧化-吸附协同去除机制、微生物群落功能分化理论
AI.method: 比较乙酸钠和葡萄糖作为碳源对Mn-AGS系统的影响，通过pH监测、锰氧化活性测定、砷去除效率评估、Fe(II)补充实验、微生物群落分析等方法进行研究
AI.findings: 乙酸代谢驱动渐进碱化(pH 7.0→9.5)，促进锰氧化；乙酸培养的Mn-AGS在酸性胁迫下保持结构完整性；处理含砷废水时实现50.2-69.3% As(III)去除，Fe(II)补充后提升至89.2%；发现Paracoccus为核心锰氧化菌属，Fe(II)条件下酸耐受菌Hydrogenophaga和Flavobacterium增殖

AI.practical_contributions: 开发了无需预中和的直接酸性废水处理技术；为采矿冶金行业含砷废水处理提供了可持续解决方案；确定了乙酸作为优化碳源的选择策略
